notes.title: Escape from Skull Dungeon is released
notes.notes:
Escape from Skull Dungeon is now available!

You find yourself trapped in a dungeon-themed castle. Solve puzzles, crack riddles, elude demons, dodge traps and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to escape Skull Dungeon.

After receiving feedback from our previous game, Escape from Kyoto House, we have made this game tougher and added elements that you would not be able to find in a real escape room...

Will you Escape from Skull Dungeon?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37854068/d4fd757da40aede9ab723853377b5c1a2a2699c8.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1379200]Click here to play now![/url]

notes.title: Horror Mode is live!
notes.notes:
Horror Mode is a new way to experience Escape from Kyoto House. The puzzles have been shuffled around and the lights are off, but that's not the only change.

We don't want to spoil anything for you, but you may notice three little hearts on your screen. That's how many collective lives your team has - run out of them and it's Game Over. How can you lose lives, you ask? Well, we're certainly not going to tell you...

Even if you've finished the game before, this spooky adventure is worth playing through again. So grab your friends and brace yourselves for Escape from Kyoto House - Horror Mode!

notes.title: New Horror Mode coming soon!
notes.notes:
Last week we launched Escape from Kyoto House. Hundreds of you have already escaped, but what comes next?

We are already planning a new escape room, but that will take a little while to prepare. So we're doing something a little special - Escape from Kyoto House is getting a terrifying new Horror Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37854068/ae2d9eeecf9dba2a25918604fd355a346febdb3f.png[/img]


What does that mean?
[list]
[*]New Horror Theme - Escaping is easy with the lights on. And nothing chasing you...
[*]Monsters! - Is something lurking in the dark? We don't want to spoil anything for you, but you may want to find a good hiding place.
[*]Health system - You can now die in the game, and you will only have so many lives to spend before the game ends. For multiplayer games, these lives are shared. 
[*]Remixed puzzles - You'll encounter the same puzzles, but most will require a different solution.
[/list]

This will be a 100% free update for everyone who owns the game - no DLCs, in-app purchases, freemium content or whatever you crazy kids call it these days. It will be included in the base game.

We'll get you more news ASAP, but we're hopeful to launch this very soon.

Taichi Games
